signal_text: Gumroad's Terms of Service (effective January 1, 2025) states that Gumroad currently uses Stripe, Inc. and its affiliates, and PayPal, as third-party service providers for payment processing including card acceptance and merchant settlement.
subject_exact: Gumroad payment processing providers (Stripe and PayPal) for card acceptance and merchant settlement
extraction_notes: 'Currently' qualifier signals potential for change. Stripe and PayPal named as payment processors. The snippet covers checkout infrastructure (card acceptance, merchant settlement) — not seller payout rails. However, PayPal appears in both checkout and payout contexts on Gumroad; this snippet refers to payment processing (checkout layer). Ambiguity preserved.
